name: @r-irbe/force-sqlite-to-turso
description: Agent-agnostic tooling to rewire any coding agent's better-sqlite3 usage: NODE_OPTIONS preload shim, telemetry, local single-writer server lifecycle, a sync bridge (better-sqlite3 API over Hrana), libsql mode with Bearer auth, a SIGKILL chaos harness, and a pi extension.
